options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

options.name: ca_file
options.description: Path to the CA certificate SSL file for verify registry server certificate.

options.name: cert_file
options.description: Path to the client certificate SSL file for identify registry client using this certificate file.

options.name: host
options.description: Provide a URL for accessing the registry.

options.name: insecure
options.description: Allow connections to SSL sites without certs.

options.name: key_file
options.description: Path to the client key SSL file for identify registry client using this key file.

options.name: plain_http
options.description: Use insecure HTTP connections for C(helm registry login). Requires Helm >= 3.18.0

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the registry. If set to V(present) attempt to log in to the remote registry server using the URL specified in O(host). If set to V(absent) attempt to log out from the remote registry server using the URL specified in O(host). As helm >= 3.18.0 reports successful logout even if the user is not logged in, this module will report a change regardless of the current state.
